name: Note Claim Refresh
description: Auto-refresh the live-session claim on any edit/write/apply_patch to a memory/_note_*.md the agent already holds. Makes the note_claim_protocol enforceable without the agent remembering to run claim_note.sh refresh each turn.

workspaceDir.description: Absolute path to the agent workspace whose memory/_note_*.md this plugin protects. If omitted, resolved dynamically from OPENCLAW_WORKSPACE, the tool call's target note path, or ctx.
